name: gene_finding_benchmark_v1
description: A benchmark for evaluating models' ability to locate and annotate genes from raw nucleotide sequences. It measures performance on tasks such as identifying gene boundaries, predicting coding regions, and producing gene annotations from sequence input. The suite is intended to assess sequence-modeling capabilities of language models applied to genomics problems.
reputation: A specialized benchmark from the DNA-LLM community with focused use among researchers applying LLMs to genomic sequence tasks.
